estimator.name: utf8-byte4-v1
estimator.definition: ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 4) per unique repository source, summed after de-duplication
estimator.material_saving_rule: pre_estimate - post_estimate must exceed pre_uncertainty + post_uncertainty

process_envelope.scope: Three-layer static budget. Base profile budgets cover repository-owned initial_reads. Conditional-profile budgets cover the checker-owned superset of every fixed repository source named or required by canonical conditional_reads for that profile. Route-effective budgets cover concrete H1/CITY/PA mandatory capsule/non-compressible/escalation sets. Live GitHub state, PR diff bytes and candidate-specific exact dependency/evidence payloads remain mandatory but are held outside this static corpus budget because CTX does not control their identity or size.

same_snapshot_measurement.snapshot_contract: All pre/post file bytes are read from the same checked-out candidate snapshot. Pre-CTX routing is reconstructed from checker-owned canonical representative direct-predecessor sources, not from the compact artifacts being measured. Post-CTX routing is the accepted canonical role profile plus validated capsule navigation and checker-owned route-forced mandatory conditionals. Fixed conditional profile coverage is independently bounded even when a fixed conditional is not activated by one of the six representative measurement routes. Sources that remain binding in both designs are held constant. Dynamic live GitHub/diff/candidate-specific exact dependency inputs are mandatory but excluded from the static delta.
